highlights.description: Initial release: a thin, read-only Go SDK for the ProductBoard REST API v2, covering Features, Releases, and Objectives via ProductBoard's generic Entities API
omniroadmap-core Provider adapter for wiring ProductBoard into omniroadmap-based tooling

added.description: Vendored ProductBoard OpenAPI 3.1.1 Entities spec and ogen-generated low-level API client (`internal/api`)
`APIError` type with `IsNotFound`, `IsUnauthorized`, `IsRateLimited` helpers for classifying API failures
`Feature`/`Release`/`Objective` types and `Get*`/`List*` methods built on ProductBoard's generic Entities API
Field-value parsing helpers that type each dynamic entity field-value shape (status, member, select options, timeframe) by inspecting it at runtime
`omniroadmap.Provider` implementing omniroadmap-core's `provider.Provider` interface, supporting `ListItems`/`GetItem` for features and objectives, and `ListReleases`

tests.description: Unit tests covering client construction, field-value parsing, `Get*`/`List*` for features/releases/objectives, and the omniroadmap provider's conversions and unsupported-operation paths, including omniroadmap-core's provider conformance suite

documentation.description: README covering scope, ProductBoard's dynamic field model, and quick start usage

infrastructure.description: GitHub Actions workflows for Go build/test, golangci-lint, and CodeQL static analysis

internal.description: Go module definition, dependency lockfile, Makefile targets, ogen generation script/config, and golangci-lint config
